segments.en:
We strive earnestly, and we take up our Yasna and our homage
to the good waters, and to the fertile fruit-trees (which bear
as of themselves), and to the Fravashis of the saints; yea, we
take up our Yasna, and our homage earnestly to those beings which
are (so) good, the waters, and the trees, and the Fravashis of
the saints, (2) and to the Kine, and to Gaya (Maretan) [Gayomard], and to
the Manthra Spenta (the bounteous word-of-reason), the holy, which
works (within and for us with effect), to these we take up our
Yasnas and our homage with earnest zeal, and to Thee, O Ahura
Mazda I and to thee, O Zarathushtra, we do the same; and to thee,
O lofty lord (the Apam-napat), and to the Bountiful Immortals.
segments.zh:
我們誠摯地努力，並舉起我們的亞斯納和我們的敬拜
向良好之水，以及向結果豐盛之果樹（其結果
正如它們自身)，以及向聖者的弗拉瓦希；是的，我們
舉起我們的亞斯納，以及我們的誠摯敬拜獻給那些存在
是（如此）良好，水，樹木，以及聖者的弗拉瓦希
聖者，（2）以及向牛群，以及向蓋亞（馬雷坦）[蓋奧瑪德]，以及向
曼特拉‧斯彭塔（恩惠的理性之言），聖者，哪
作用（在我們內部並為我們產生效果），對這些我們繼續我們的
亞斯納以及我們以熱誠的敬意，以及向你，啊阿胡拉
馬茲達 I以及向你，啊查拉圖斯特拉，我們亦如此；以及向你，
啊崇高的領主（阿帕姆納帕特），以及向大天神。

segments.en:
And we sacrifice to the listening (that hears our prayers)
and to that mercy, and to the hearing of (our spoken) homage,
and to that mercy which is (shown in response to our offered)
praise. And we sacrifice to the fraraiti vidushe , which is contained
in the piece hvadaenaish ashaonis ; and we sacrifice to 'the good
praise which is without hypocrisy, and which has no malice (as
its end)'; and we sacrifice to the later Yasna and to its offering;
and we sacrifice to the chapters of the later Yasna, and to its
metrical lines, its words, and word-structure.
segments.zh:
並且我們向傾聽（那聽見我們的禱告）獻祭
並且對該慈悲，並且對（我們口頭的）敬拜的聽聞，
並且對該慈悲，那是（顯示為回應我們所奉獻的）
讚美。並且我們向弗拉賴提‧維杜舍獻祭，那是被包含的
在 hvadaenaish ashaonis 這件作品中；並且我們獻祭給『善良的
讚美，那是沒有虛偽的，而且那是沒有惡意的（為
其末'); 和我們獻祭給後來的亞斯納及其供獻;
和我們獻祭給後來的亞斯納的章節，和其
詩句，其詞彙，以及詞結構。
